cc:Work.dc:description: Approximate digitization of raster Fig. 8(b), archived in 论文所有图.pptx, ppt/media/image177.png through image180.png. Not original trial data. All text uses Times New Roman. Mean smoothed for display with Gaussian sigma 6 timesteps and blend 0.8; visible source standard-deviation band retained. User-specified timestep scaling: case 1 x0.016; case 2 x0.013. These factors are not recovered execution-time measurements.
